source: TO BE CITED: Jay to confirm the origin of the '10-12 core slides' guidance before this is shown to anyone.
weights_note: Weights are PROVISIONAL and are the author's own choice, not taken from a published source. Treat them as a modelling assumption.
scale: 1 = missing or very weak, 5 = strong and evidence-backed

criteria.name: Cover (one-line pitch)
criteria.description: States what the company does in one clear line.
criteria.low: No clear statement of what the company does.
criteria.high: One line a stranger can repeat; name, logo and contact are present.

criteria.name: Problem
criteria.description: Names who has the problem and why it hurts.
criteria.low: Vague or generic problem, no affected customer named.
criteria.high: Specific customer, specific pain, supported by evidence or a quote.

criteria.name: Solution
criteria.description: Explains the product and how it solves the problem.
criteria.low: Buzzwords only, unclear what the product does.
criteria.high: Clear product description that maps directly to the stated problem.

criteria.name: Why now
criteria.description: Explains what has changed that makes this possible or urgent today.
criteria.high: A concrete shift (technology, regulation, behaviour) with evidence.

criteria.name: Market size
criteria.description: Sizes the market with a believable method.
criteria.low: Only a huge top-down number with no source.
criteria.high: Sourced figures and a bottom-up estimate of reachable customers.

criteria.name: Traction
criteria.description: Shows evidence that people want this (users, revenue, pilots, growth).
criteria.high: Real numbers with time period and growth trend.

criteria.name: Business model
criteria.description: Explains how the company makes money.
criteria.high: Clear pricing, who pays, and unit economics or margins.

criteria.name: Competition
criteria.description: Shows who else solves this and why this company wins.
criteria.high: Honest comparison with real alternatives and a clear edge.

criteria.name: Team
criteria.description: Shows why this team can execute.
criteria.high: Relevant experience for each founder and key hires or gaps.

criteria.name: Roadmap and go-to-market
criteria.description: Explains how customers will be reached and what gets built next.

criteria.name: Funding ask
criteria.description: States how much is being raised and what it will achieve.
criteria.low: No amount or no use of funds.
criteria.high: Amount, use of funds, and the milestones it reaches.
